# Backup and Restore Checklist

## Backup Plan
- [ ] PostgreSQL backup schedule exists
- [ ] Backup destination is encrypted
- [ ] Backup retention period is defined
- [ ] Access to backups is restricted

## Restore Validation
- [ ] Restore test performed on non-production environment
- [ ] Data integrity checks passed after restore
- [ ] App startup validated after restore
- [ ] Restore time measured and recorded

## RPO/RTO
- [ ] RPO target documented
- [ ] RTO target documented
- [ ] Incident response owner assigned
